{"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (378 rows) arrived with source_tz='UTC', while all earlier batches are America/Chicago local time. Its txn_ts values run from 12:00 UTC on 01-18 to 04:56 UTC on 01-19, which is 06:00 to about 23:00 Chicago time on 01-18. silver_transactions treats these as local time, so the evening transactions spill onto 2026-01-19. The fix converts UTC-sourced timestamps to America/Chicago before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH t AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       local_ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM t;"}}
